notes: Keep the production A15 userscript stable while add-on modules are developed and tested independently.
The GUI is a replaceable skin and may only use the stable window.GremlinA15 bridge exposed by the headless control-center.
GUI code must not query ImageTrend controls, call Knockout, or own chart mutation logic.
Each module must fail closed: a module error must not disable the A15 core.
Persistent user profiles live under the runtime storage schema and must survive module updates.
Reconstruction is metadata-only by default and must not become a keystroke or patient-text logger.
Structural drift may reduce capability to REVIEW/BLOCKED; uncertainty never authorizes a broader write.
Unknown native action signatures are discovered but never guessed or invoked.
Clinical and protocol writes require an explicit user action and must resolve and verify their target before proceeding.
IV and IO are distinct medication administration routes and route-consistency logic must preserve that distinction.
Procedure equipment size remains quarantined from categorical Adult/Pediatric automation until its numeric semantics are validated.
Native AI integration invokes ImageTrend's own AI controls only after explicit user action; A15 does not export chart content to a separate AI service.
No module may automatically Save, post, finish, transfer, or submit a chart.
